name: Front Beach
kicker: The arc between the two mountains
summary: The curved seafront between Big and Small Mountain: walk it at sunrise, or after dark for a drink. Its old name, Tầm Dương, is tied to looking for the sun, and sunrise is the moment here. In the evening the promenade is the lively side of town. Pair it with Bach Dinh and the cable car at the north end.
getThere: Taxi or motorbike taxi from Back Beach.
heroCaption: The Front Beach arc, the water, and the headland

notice.title: This is not the swim
notice.body: The gentle waves for swimming are on Back Beach. Front Beach is the walk and the evening.

body: Walk the promenade along the arc between Big Mountain and Small Mountain, with buildings on one side and the bay on the other. The beach is also called Bãi Tầm Dương, a name tied to looking for the sun. Come at sunrise, though the water is still bright at sunset.

In the evening the seafront is the lively side of town, with drinks by the water. On the whale festival morning, the 16th of the 8th lunar month, the boat procession sets out from the park here. In 2026 it left at 5:30.
Trần Phú runs north from the arc round Big Mountain, past Bach Dinh and the Ho May cable-car station.

gettingThere: Front Beach is the southwest side of the peninsula. From a Back Beach hotel, take a taxi or motorbike taxi across town.

legs.heading: From Back Beach
legs.body: A ride across the peninsula by taxi or motorbike taxi.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: By GreenlinesDP fast ferry, about two hours. Confirm the Vung Tau landing pier when you book.
